name: Pesky Dust
abilities: Sleep dust (hypno-koniokinesis) - puts nearly any species to sleep, even Celestialsapiens
Dream entry and observation - reads a sleeping victim's dreams (used to interrogate Khyber)
Dream manipulation (oneirokinesis) - reshapes dreams or induces nightmares
Can enter and control the dreams of any number of sleepers simultaneously
Flight on fairy-like wings, leaving a green trail
weaknesses: Sleep effect is temporary - victims must be re-dosed to stay under
Some beings are immune: Gutrot's species and the Nemuina's natural predator (secondary brain cluster)
Still affected by other Nemuinas' dust
Physically tiny and frail with no direct attacks
summary: A blue Tinker Bell-like sprite whose sleeping dust drops almost anyone, after which Ben can walk into and rewrite their dreams.
traits: Trills, chirps and purrs when he talks (after his voice changed from Ben's in his second appearance)
Design from Lillimusha DiForestini; powers compared by Derrick J. Wyatt to Jigglypuff's Sing
Khyber is terrified of Nemuinas and considers his Pesky Dust dream his worst nightmare
Kai finds him cute; Ben considers him 'nobody to mess with'
notableFeats: Put Khyber to sleep and pulled Albedo's destination out of his dream (For a Few Brains More)
Defeated Charles Zenith by trapping him in nightmares (The Most Dangerous Game Show)
Escaped Liam after being accidentally unlocked (Outbreak)

appearances.designNotes: Short blue-skinned fairy with purple wings, pink spots and cheek markings, upright blue hair, green dress-like outfit with black zigzags, white gloves, three fingers and two toes; Omnitrix symbol on chest.

scoring.rationale: Special 6: sleep dust that works on almost everything (Celestialsapiens included) plus dream reading and nightmare torture - it beat Charles Zenith and cracked Khyber. Flight gives real mobility, but he is tiny and fragile with no proper attack, the sleep wears off, and a few species are immune.

notes: One of four aliens accidentally unlocked by Blukic and Driba in Outbreak (with Walkatrout, Mole-Stache and The Worst); voiced by Yuri Lowenthal in Outbreak, then Tara Strong.
Ben 23 counterpart: Nighty Knight. Albedo cannot transform into Pesky Dust.
A cameo by Reboot Ben in the Brazilian crossover 'The Unfiltered World of Any Malu' and comic uses (Super Secret Crisis War!) are excluded.
